answer: Traffic-shape phase admission: at the reef edge, the wharf gateway and atlas coordinator assign each agent a pseudorandom request phase plus a target inter-arrival histogram per 5-minute window. Ingress rejects windows whose burstiness or autocorrelation deviates from that profile and flags cross-correlated timing across identities. A Sybil cluster’s shared scheduler produces detectable synchronized bursts; to pass, an attacker must emulate independent idle/active cycles for every identity, multiplying orchestration cost and delaying usable throughput.
